posts.title: Cousins into strangers
posts.description: It breaks my heart how my favorite cousin and I have become strangers. Life has its own puzzles and purposes, but I know for a fact I will always be here for him.

posts.title: Here I am
posts.description: I decided to delete social media apps from my phone. I’m exhausted by this mindless consumption. I will still post content on those networks via desktop browser. I’ve also published a new track on music streaming services which I will upload links soon.

posts.title: Daily Habits and Recent Updates
posts.description: I’m not a big fan of social networks, and I’m sure plenty share this ideology with me. But we also have to admit that we keep on using them despite our hatred towards them and our ideal fantasies of throwing away our phones and living off the grid.
